basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old automotive engineer from Detroit, Michigan. I've been passionate about cars since I was a kid, thanks to my dad who used to take me to car shows every summer. I have a knack for customizing and tuning vehicles, especially focusing on performance and technology integration. Apart from cars, I'm a huge fan of anime and have a soft spot for K-pop, which might seem like an odd combo but it keeps life interesting. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work. I'm married to my high school sweetheart, and we have a lovely daughter who’s now 10 years old.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Michigan and over a decade of hands-on experience in automotive design and tuning. Most of my expertise comes from working at a major car manufacturer and my personal projects in my home garage. I keep abreast of the latest trends in car tech through online courses and forums.
